Kings Park Rangers Football Club is an English football club. They play in the Eastern Counties League Division One North and play at Blackhouse Lane, in Great Cornard, a groundshare with Cornard United.
History
Founded in May 2023, they won back-to-back promotions as they were runners up of the Essex and Suffolk Border League Division 1 in 2023-24 and Border League Premier Division winners in 2024–25, qualifying them for Step 6 (Level 10) of the National League system for the first time.
During their first season in the National League system, the club achieved promotion to step 5 as Eastern Counties League Division One North champions.
Honours
*Eastern Counties Football League
**Division One North champions: 2025–26
*Essex and Suffolk Border Football League
**Premier Division champions: 2024–25
**Division One runners-up: 2023–24
